content:
Every direction fails. This strongly suggests I'm stuck inside the notice board object. Let me re-read: "Notice Board (notice) at (2,7): blocks". And I'm at (2,7). 

Perhaps the fix is that the notice board is actually at a tile I need to step off, but the game considers my current tile occupied. Let me try pressing E to interact with the notice board on my own tile — maybe reading it moves me or the notice is what I'm standing on.

Actually, let me reconsider whether the notice board might be at (1,7) and the "at (2,7)" is a rounding. When I faced left, E said "nothing at 1,7". When facing up, "nothing at 2,6". So the notice board is genuinely at (2,7) = my tile.

Let me try a very long hold in one direction to rule out slow movement, and also try pressing E repeatedly.
